name: Pharmacology & Toxicology Basics
summary: How drugs and toxic chemicals act on the body and how the body absorbs, transforms and removes them.

topics.name: Pharmacodynamics: receptor theory, agonists, antagonists and dose-response
Pharmacokinetics: absorption, distribution, metabolism and excretion (ADME)
Compartment models, half-life, clearance and bioavailability
Drug metabolism: cytochrome P450 and phase I/II reactions
Principles of toxicology: dose-response, LD50 and NOAEL
Mechanisms of toxicity: reactive metabolites and oxidative stress
Toxicity of common industrial chemicals, solvents and metals
